# Component inventory

Every component in the library, what it is, its sizing rule, and which screens render it. Check here before inventing something - if a pattern is already here, use it; if it is not, that is a grey box and a new component.

53 components across 10 categories.

---

## Actions

| component | what it is | sizing | used on |
|---|---|---|---|
| `buttons` | Primary (navy fill) and outline (navy border) variants, at Crystal's large, medium and small sizes. Large takes the label to --vpButtonText16BoldValmo and the control to 48px; small drops it to --vpButtonText2 and 32px. | Large 48px, medium 36px, small 32px; all three on a 6px radius and a 1px border. | `payments-list`, `payment-details`, `pilot-management-list`, `add-new-pilot`, `service-area-misrouted`, `growth-dashboard`, `growth-dashboard-design-happy`, `growth-dashboard-design-sad`, `dc-capacity` |
| `language-button` | Per-section Hindi explainer: play glyph plus label, outlined in brand navy on the light grey fill. Two lengths ship on this page — the short हिंदी inside a metric card and the full हिंदी में जानकारी beside a section title. | 32px tall; width hugs the label. | `growth-dashboard`, `growth-dashboard-design-happy`, `growth-dashboard-design-sad`, `dc-capacity` |
| `sticky-action-bar` | The totals a form is about to commit, pinned to the bottom of the work area with the action that commits them, so a half-set form cannot scroll out of sight. Values read as a dash until something is entered. | Full width, pinned bottom, 12/16 padding on a 1px top rule. | `dc-capacity` |
| `segmented-toggle` | Pill-style toggle group for switching a date range or view. | hug | `payments-list` |
| `search-input` | Icon-prefixed search box used above data tables. | hug | `pilot-management-list`, `add-new-pilot` |

| `waterfall-chart` | Max possible orders, what was lost, what was gained, and what finally shipped. A zero column draws as a red rule rather than a bar with no height, and the increment column is the yellow that its legend swatch repeats. | 300px tall; 64px bars; heights are proportional to the largest value. | `growth-dashboard` |
| `reason-group` | One cause behind the order count, its legend swatch matching the chart, and the measurements behind it. The measurements share a single outlined card divided by a rule, rather than sitting as separate tiles. The swatch is the join between the chart and the explanation - same colour, same meaning. | Rows are 8px-rounded on --vpGreyLight02, 12px apart. | `growth-dashboard` |
| `status-dot` | A section's health, read before its title. Green on a green halo when every metric is on target, red when one is not. DESIGN ONLY — the shipped panel has no such marker. | 10px on a 3px halo. | `growth-dashboard-design-happy`, `growth-dashboard-design-sad` |
| `banner-pill` | The movement behind the order count, sitting inside the orders banner. Green with a rising trend when orders were gained, red with a falling one when they were missed. DESIGN ONLY. | Hugs its label; 12px radius. | `growth-dashboard-design-happy`, `growth-dashboard-design-sad` |
| `accordion-row` | Real expand/collapse breakdown rows (native <details>) — Base Pay / Adjustments / Losses in a payment breakup, with the real per-line items underneath. | hug | `payment-details` |
| `step-chart` | The design's chart. Where the live Waterfall Chart shows a plain bar per stage, this draws each change as its own step — a dashed arrow and a tinted block floated to the level the change happened at — over dashed gridlines. Yellow for a gain, red for a loss. DESIGN ONLY. | 342px plot on a 341px baseline; 60px bars; heights proportional to the largest value. | `growth-dashboard-design-happy`, `growth-dashboard-design-sad` |
| `reason-card` | A measurement behind a missed order: what was measured, over which window, its value with a status chip, and how far off it was. The design's answer to the live Reason Group's row. DESIGN ONLY. | White on a 1px stroke, 8px radius, 12/16 padding. | `growth-dashboard-design-happy`, `growth-dashboard-design-sad` |
| `capacity-card` | A reason the captain can act on, so it closes with the action rather than the number. The only card on the page that links out. DESIGN ONLY. | As Reason Card, plus a closing action line. | `growth-dashboard-design-sad` |
| `recommendation-card` | What the panel thinks the DC can actually take, sitting beside the field rather than under it so the two numbers can be read against each other. | Grey, 6px radius, 16px padding. | `dc-capacity` |

## Forms

| component | what it is | sizing | used on |
|---|---|---|---|
| `capacity-field` | A number the captain is asking for, with its unit held inside the field and the panel's answer beneath. Three states, shown here in order: below the workable band and above it both read red, and a value inside the band is confirmed in green — the field is never silent once it holds a number. | 46px field on a 6px radius; the message sits 8px below. | `dc-capacity` |
| `layer-checkbox-row` | Bordered checkbox row with a right-side legend token (warning triangle, coloured dot or dashed line). Unchecked rows mute their label; on a map screen each row shows/hides its own marker group. | hug | `service-area-my-area`, `service-area-misrouted` |
| `date-range-field` | Bordered field showing a calendar icon and the active in-scan range, with the Edit Date Range pencil that opens the picker. | hug | `service-area-misrouted` |
| `date-range-picker` | From/To fields, month stepper, Sun-Sat grid with the selected range filled (dark endpoints, tinted days between), the 30-day limit note and Apply. UI only - selection is not wired. | hug | `service-area-misrouted` |
| `awb-search-field` | Text field paired with a solid navy chevron submit button, for looking a shipment up by AWB number. | hug | `service-area-find-shipment` |
